scope: Official GPX availability and 2027 course-version review for top-level events 71–80
safetyRules: Existing GPX files remain valid until a new official file is downloaded, parsed and validated.
No existing GPX files were deleted, overwritten or replaced.
A readable XML preview does not mean the track was parsed or its distance/elevation validated.
Do not label historic GPX files as current 2027 routes.

checks.detail: Organizer facts page states the 2027 edition is 23–24 July in Haidmühle and lists eight courses (despite a summary sentence saying seven). Distances/ascent are edition-specific and revised for 2027. Do not use 2024 tracks. Extract each route page GPX separately.

Official 2027 Diamond page confirms 68.37km/3309m and 24 July 2027. Clicking its GPX download opens a GPX 1.1 XML preview with track name Diamond Run (68), but the URL filename is StreckeDiamond2026.gpx. Treat it as historical 2026 data, not a 2027 replacement. No parser validation performed.

Official event page confirms five 2027 competitions. GGUT 110km/6500hm and GGT 57km/3500hm are explicit on official pages. Route files are not publicly exposed as direct GPX in this pass; check official event app or athlete pack.

checks.gpxStatus: official-2027-event-and-route-distances-confirmed; GPX download page still exposes 2026 track
checks.detail: Current official race pages show 25–27 June 2027 and 2027 course data. UltraTrail route page carries a 20 May 2026 status and GPX link to 2026_UltraTrail.gpx. The web viewer rejects application/gpx+xml; URL itself proves old version. Do not use it as 2027 track.
Official UTMB race list confirms seven formats and 2027 dates. Individual map exports must be checked separately; no GPX binary retrieved.
Official UTMB homepage confirms 30 July–1 August 2027 and six races with the listed distances/ascent. Detail pages are still marked Opening soon, so no official GPX is available yet.

Current official 2027 page corrects route figures versus the older checkpoint: P105 103km/6000m, P90 87/5200, P60 63/4300, P45 Glacier 45/2900, P45 Rifflsee 43/2100, P30 27/1300, P15 16/800, Young Talents 8/640. Eight adult/youth course pages plus separate P Kids navigation. No file downloaded.

Official UTMB page confirms a completely new one-loop route of 52km/3100m+ for 7 August 2027. Route is viewable online for orientation but GPX download is explicitly unavailable pending minor adjustments. Do not use old two-loop GPX as 2027.

Current organizer homepage shows Vertical 10K and Kids Run in addition to 50K/100K/160K and Matterhorning. Matterhorning is specifically a 2027 tenth-anniversary race. Previous checkpoint omitted Vertical and Kids Run. Download pages exist for major routes, but direct file URLs and file versions need separate checking.

Official Ultra page links to an Outdooractive map. Aid stations place the route finish at approximately 69.5km, but page does not expose a public organizer-hosted GPX download. Use organizer map or request file; do not invent direct GPX URL.

criticalFindings: 3Kings3Hills 2027 has eight distinct distances, with new 2027-specific metrics; prior checkpoint route count and older metrics should be reconciled.
Davos Diamond 2027 page links to StreckeDiamond2026.gpx; XML is readable but clearly old.
SachsenTrail 2027 race page currently exposes 2026_UltraTrail.gpx; reject as stale.
Pitz Alpine official 2027 metrics have changed from prior checkpoint values; update all eight distances to current official figures.
KAT100 Marathon Trail is a completely new 52km/3100m one-loop route, but GPX download remains disabled until final small adjustments.
Swiss Alps 100 current program includes Vertical 10K and Kids Run as well as Matterhorning, 50K, 100K and 160K.

followUps: 3Kings3Hills: extract and validate GPX for all eight 2027 routes; ensure app metrics match 2027 facts page, not 2024 edition.
Davos X-Trails: obtain new 2027 Diamond GPX; inspect Gold/Silver/Bronze/Vertical and kids routes for correct version.
GGUT: retrieve current route files from official app or race pack; validate five race formats separately.
SachsenTrail: obtain 2027 GPX for Ultra, Half, Quarter, Base, Fun, Uphill and kids routes; current public Ultra link still points to 2026.
Gauja: export seven current UTMB Map + GPX routes and validate each.
Quito: recheck when race detail pages open and final GPX is published.

KAT100: recheck after organizer finalizes new Marathon Trail route and enables download; old course remains historical.

currentEventDatesCrossCheck.note: This batch follows the historic top-level EVENTS order. Eight current catalog entries overlap directly; Last Soul Ultra and Karnisches Ungetüm are covered by audit batch 61. 3Kings 3Hills and Davos X-Trails are legacy entries not in the current event-dates range.
